name: Shenandoah National Park & Skyline Drive
summary: A 105-mile ridgeline drive through the Blue Ridge, with waterfalls, overlooks, and the largest caverns in the East just below.

lodging.name: Big Meadows Lodge (in-park) or a Luray inn
lodging.blurb: Stay on the ridge at Big Meadows or in the valley town of Luray.

foodMustTry.name: Blackberry ice cream pie at Big Meadows

days.label: Day 146 — Skyline Drive
days.summary: The Blue Ridge from end to end.

item.title: Drive Skyline Drive

location.name: Shenandoah National Park
location.address: Skyline Dr, Shenandoah National Park, VA

item.blurb: 105 miles of ridgeline with 75 overlooks; watch for deer and black bears and stop at Big Meadows.

item.title: Dark Hollow Falls hike

location.name: Dark Hollow Falls Trailhead
location.address: Dark Hollow Falls Trail, Shenandoah NP, VA

item.blurb: A short, steep walk to a lovely 70-ft cascade — the most accessible waterfall in the park.

days.label: Day 147 — Luray Caverns
days.summary: The underground half of the Blue Ridge.

item.title: Luray Caverns
item.blurb: The largest caverns in the eastern U.S. — cathedral-sized rooms and the one-of-a-kind Great Stalacpipe Organ.

days.label: Day 148 — Down to Charlottesville
days.summary: Off the ridge to Jefferson's town.

commute.scenicNote: East over the Blue Ridge into the Piedmont.
